aggregation.definition: arithmetic mean over the frozen scored opportunity set; invalid/missing observations are not coerced to zero

primary_variables.mean_nll_delta: candidate mean Gaussian NLL minus comparator mean Gaussian NLL over the metric's frozen scored window
primary_variables.scored_count: number of valid scored observations in the frozen window
primary_variables.stable_dependency_nll_increase: post-change stable-channel mean NLL minus pre-change stable-channel mean NLL
primary_variables.post_change_nll_delta: late post-change mean NLL minus early post-change mean NLL
primary_variables.resource_accounting_complete: true only when every required candidate resource observation is present and within its frozen envelope
primary_variables.c1_persistence_pass: true only when every C1 primary P metric threshold passes
primary_variables.c2_persistence_pass: true only when every C2 primary P metric threshold and resource requirement passes
